findings.title: Filter-before-interpolate changes empty-query handling
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery now does request.targets.filter(query.expr).filter(!hide).map(applyTemplateVariables). The old code called interpolateVariablesInQueries first and then filtered on the interpolated expr. A query whose raw expr is truthy but interpolates to empty (e.g. a variable that resolves to empty) will now be kept and sent to fetchLabelValues / sharding instead of being dropped, and a query with empty raw expr that would interpolate to a selector is now dropped. Filtering must happen after interpolation to preserve the old semantics.

findings.title: Empty check runs on uninterpolated expr
findings.body: runSplitQuery filters on query.expr and only then maps through datasource.applyTemplateVariables. Queries that become empty only after interpolation (variable resolves to empty string) will still be grouped, time-partitioned and executed, and the hidden/empty tracking expectations no longer match the executed targets. The empty-expr filter should be applied to the interpolated query, not the raw query.

findings.title: Shard path interpolates twice via nested runSplitQuery
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery interpolates with applyTemplateVariables and then delegates each shard group to runSplitQuery, which interpolates again. The updated test expects applyTemplateVariables to be called 5 times for a single target instead of 1. Repeated template replacement is wasted work and unsafe if replacement is not idempotent (an interpolated value containing $ or $__ syntax would be re-expanded/corrupted on the second pass).
